route: Work Permit (Work Permit Entry Pass), then the Work Visa

permit.applies: The employer, through the Xpat Online System (the employer or an authorised representative also applies for the Work e-Visa).
permit.first: A foreign employment quota for the worksite, and a job posting on the Ministry's Job Center Portal for the local market.

fees.what: Quota fee per quota slot, for 12 months

sources.title: Maldives Immigration, Work Visa Service
sources.said: The employer or authorized representative must apply for and obtain the Work e-Visa within fifteen (15) days of the employee's arrival in the Maldives on a valid Entry Pass (Work Permit) issued by the Ministry of Homeland Security and Technology. … The validity of the Work e-Visa will correspond directly to the validity of the approved Work Permit. … Renewed Work Visas will be issued with a maximum validity of one (1) year.

sources.title: CTL Strategies, Regulation on Employment of Expatriate Workers — quoting Regulation No. 2023/R-111 (Regulation on Employment of Expatriate Workers), published in the Government Gazette (gazette.gov.mv); the Gazette's search for '2023/R-111' (all types and regulations, saved MV-g2.html, MV-g3.html) lists no item, so the regulation's own page URL couldn't be given (2026-11-01)
sources.said: Step 3 – Quota Application: The employer will need to obtain a foreign employment quota from the Ministry in connection with the business activity undertaken at the worksite. … employers must post a job offering on the Ministry’s Job Center Portal seeking employees from the local market before bringing foreign employees into the Maldives. … Under the Regulation, the work permit will be valid for the period the Work Permit Fee is paid. … MVR 2,000 (circa USD 130) per quota slot (i.e. each slot in the respective quota pool) payable for a period of 12 months. … MVR 350 (circa USD 22.7) per month for each respective employee on a work permit.

note: Layer 3 holds the Work Visa alone. The Work Visa rests on a work permit the employer obtains first from the ministry (now the Ministry of Homeland Security and Technology, per Maldives Immigration), on a foreign employment quota and after posting the job on the Job Center Portal for the local market; a new arrival enters on the Work Permit Entry Pass and the e-Visa follows within 15 days (Immigration) or 30 days of the permit (CTL Strategies' reading of Regulation 2023/R-111). The work permit runs for as long as its MVR 350 monthly fee is paid; a renewed Work Visa runs at most one year. No performers' route or exemption was found. The fee figures are from a Maldivian law firm's summary of Regulation 2023/R-111, since MIRA's work permit fee page refuses this client (403); the deposit varies by nationality and is not held.
